description.zh: 把平均数看作倒水齐平后的水位：总量守恒，水位 = 总量 ÷ 杯数。假设水可自由倒且可分。
description.en: The mean seen as the level after pouring until even: the total is conserved and level = total ÷ cups. Assumes water pours freely and is divisible.

label.zh: 同一个平均数的两种画法

reason.zh: 倒水齐平与条形图上的平均线是同一件事：高出的部分正好补足不足的部分。
reason.en: Pouring until level and the mean line on a bar chart are the same fact: what sticks out exactly fills what falls short.

title.zh: 平均数为什么是总数除以个数？
title.en: Why is the mean the total divided by the count?

ask.zh: 把几杯不一样多的水倒匀，最后每杯水位一样高——倒匀前后，水的总量变了吗？
ask.en: If you pour several uneven cups until every cup is level, does the total amount of water change?

ask.zh: 在条形图上画一条平均线，高出这条线的部分和低于这条线的部分有什么关系？
ask.en: On a bar chart, how does the part above the mean line relate to the part below it?

reveal.zh: 总量不变，倒匀后每杯都是总量÷杯数，所以平均数就是总数除以个数；图上的平均线正好让高出部分补上不足部分。
reveal.en: The total never changes, and after levelling every cup holds total ÷ cups — that is why the mean is the total divided by the count, and the mean line on a chart is exactly where the excess fills the shortfall.
